subject: PearlCloud onboarding: procurement checklist + privacy items
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@pearlcloud.io>, Procurement Team <procurement@pearlcloud.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PearlCloud onboarding: procurement checklist + privacy items

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to start the procurement onboarding for the trial/initial integration. To keep legal and finance happy and to get a PO issued quickly, can you confirm the items below (or point me to a secure portal where we can retrieve them)? Ideally we'd like to gather everything within the next 5 business days so we can issue a PO and get you onto a Dedicated slot for the POC.

Procurement & privacy checklist (please attach files where applicable):
- Company legal name & billing address (for invoicing and PO).
- W-9 or VAT form (depending on billing entity).
- Standard DPA: do you require a vendor-signed DPA or will you accept our standard DPA? If you have a DPA template, please attach.
- Subprocessor list (current and planned) and whether any subprocessors process EU personal data.
- Data retention default policies (logs, aggregated telemetry, backups).
- Data location and cross-border transfer assurances (if EU data will be processed, note SCCs or other mechanisms).
- SOC 2 or equivalent compliance artifacts (or date when available).
- Proof of insurance (if applicable).
- Banking instructions for wire / payables and any PO reference requirements (format for PO number, invoice remittance).
- Any standard procurement terms that would require procurement/legal review (e.g., automatic renewals, auto-charges, indemnity limits).

Quick answers you can include inline are fine. If you have any standard onboarding form / spreadsheet, drop it as an attachment. CC'ing Karthik (legal ops) and Hannah (finance) so they can jump in on specific items.

Thanks — our tentative timeline: once we receive signed DPA + W-9 + bank details, Redwood finance will generate a PO within 3 business days.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Procurement Program Lead
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Sophie Turner <sophie@pearlcloud.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@pearlcloud.io>, legal@pearlcloud.io
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 12:36:00 -0500
Subject: Re: PearlCloud onboarding: procurement checklist + privacy items

Hi Neha —

Thanks — happy to kick this off. Attaching the items you requested. Short answers inline below and the attachments include more detail.

- Legal name / Billing address: PearlCloud, Inc.; 410 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105 (attached W9 for EIN).
- W-9: attached (PearlCloud_W9.pdf).
- DPA: we attached our standard DPA (PearlCloud_DPA_draft_v1.pdf). We are generally comfortable with Redwood's standard clauses but we usually request a carve-out on data retention for debug logs; we marked that in the draft.
- Subprocessors: attached csv (pearlcloud_subprocessors_20261109.csv). Primary subprocessors are AWS (us-west-2), Segment (US-based), and a managed ML infra provider (ModelServeCo). The csv includes purpose, region, and contact.
- EU transfers: we use SCCs for transfers from EU; that is noted in the subprocessor csv and the DPA.
- Retention: default telemetry/log retention is 180 days; customer data (payloads/content) retained only until contract termination or per customer instructions. See DPA section 4.2.
- SOC 2: in progress; expected completion Q1 2027. We can provide interim controls doc on request.
- Insurance: certificate available on request (we can generate to include Redwood as an additional insured if needed).
- Bank details: attached doc (bank_details_pearlcloud.docx) and our AP prefers wire transfers with PO number on invoice.

Attachments:
- PearlCloud_DPA_draft_v1.pdf (DPA with annotations)
- pearlcloud_subprocessors_20261109.csv
- PearlCloud_W9.pdf
- bank_details_pearlcloud.docx

If you'd like a short call to walk through the DPA redlines, I'm available tomorrow afternoon PST.

Cheers,
Sophie Turner
Head of Revenue Operations
Sophie@pearlcloud.io
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@pearlcloud.io>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PearlCloud onboarding: procurement checklist + privacy items

Thanks Sophie, and appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple small follow-ups from legal ops: 

1) The subprocessor csv looks good — can you confirm whether ModelServeCo (managed ML infra) processes any EU-origin personal data and, if so, whether they are subject to SCCs (we need an explicit statement)?
2) In the DPA draft you marked a debug-log carve-out; can you clarify typical debug log contents (are customer prompts/outputs ever included?) and whether logs can be purged on request sooner than the 180-day default.

If you prefer to handle clarifications in writing rather than a call, that's fine — just need clear answers so legal can sign off.

Karthik
Legal Ops (contract intake)
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@pearlcloud.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PearlCloud onboarding: procurement checklist + privacy items

Thanks all — Sophie, the attachments look to answer most of our needs. Next steps proposed: 

- Karthik: please review the DPA redlines and subprocessor notes; if anything material remains, flag for legal.
- Hannah/Finance: I'll hand the W-9 + bank info to you to start PO flow; expect a PO once legal clears DPA (Target: PO issued by 2026-11-17 if no major redlines).
- Sophie: if you can confirm ModelServeCo EU processing status and confirm purge-on-request for debug logs, we can probably close legal review quickly.

Sophie, can you reply with those two clarifications in-line or as a short follow up email? If not, happy to schedule a 20-minute sync tomorrow PST.

Appreciate the quick attention — looking forward to getting PearlCloud onboarded.

Best,
Neha
Procurement Program Lead
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
